Machine learning engineer with 10+ years of experience delivering production statistical systems across media and advertising measurement, defense, and consulting. My focus is the methodology behind population-level estimates and the verification machinery that lets those systems change safely.

## Roles

::: {.role-header}
### Senior Machine Learning Engineer
[2025 – present]{.role-dates}
:::
[VideoAmp · Remote]{.role-org}

Own a set of production statistical and ML pipelines end to end: methodology, validation, deployment, and recurring releases.

- Built and productionized large-scale statistical inference pipelines, including parallelization that substantially shortened end-to-end runtime.
- Population estimation and survey calibration: raking (iterative proportional fitting) and calibration weighting formulated as convex optimization.
- Verification layer: validation gates that fail on distributional drift from historical baselines, a regression harness that re-solves frozen fixtures through the production code path at tight numerical tolerance, all-or-nothing writes for large parallel fan-outs, and run snapshots for reproducible replay.
- Gradient-boosted models with dated versioning and freshness guards that block inference when inputs post-date the training data.

[Snowflake · Snowpark · Airflow · Python · cvxpy · scikit-learn · XGBoost · Datadog]{.stack}
